targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(total), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled')
SELECT COALESCE(sum(total), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT COALESCE(sum(total), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') AND created_at::date = current_date
SELECT COALESCE(sum(total) * 0.05, 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled')
SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(total)::numeric, 2), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled')
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(status::text) = 'cancelled') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS value FROM orders
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(status::text) = 'returned') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS value FROM orders
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) = 'delivered'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) IN ('paid','assembling','shipped')
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM products WHERE lower(status::text) = 'pending'

SELECT round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS value FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) = 'delivered' AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", sum(total) AS "GMV" FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", round((sum(total) * 0.05)::numeric, 2) AS "Доход" FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", count(*) AS "Заказы" FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", round(avg(total)::numeric, 2) AS "AOV" FROM orders WHERE lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE lower(status::text) WHEN 'created' THEN 'Создан' WHEN 'paid' THEN 'Оплачен' WHEN 'assembling' THEN 'Сборка' WHEN 'shipped' THEN 'Отправлен' WHEN 'delivered' THEN 'Доставлен' WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'Отменён' WHEN 'returned' THEN 'Возврат' ELSE status::text END AS "Статус", count(*) AS "Количество" FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT CASE lower(status::text) WHEN 'draft' THEN 'Черновик' WHEN 'pending' THEN 'На модерации' WHEN 'active' THEN 'Активен' WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'Отклонён' WHEN 'archived' THEN 'Архив' ELSE status::text END AS "Статус", count(*) AS "Количество" FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT c.name AS "Категория", round(sum(oi.price * oi.quantity)::numeric, 2) AS "GMV" FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE lower(o.status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT sp.shop_name AS "Магазин", round(sum(o.total)::numeric, 2) AS "Оборот" FROM orders o JOIN seller_profiles sp ON sp.id = o.seller_id WHERE lower(o.status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY sp.shop_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT oi.title AS "Товар", sum(oi.quantity) AS "Продано" FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE lower(o.status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY oi.title ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", count(*) AS "Users" FROM users GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT sp.shop_name AS "Магазин", count(*) AS "Доставлено", round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.delivered_at - o.shipped_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Среднее время, ч" FROM orders o JOIN seller_profiles sp ON sp.id = o.seller_id WHERE lower(o.status::text) = 'delivered' AND o.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sp.shop_name ORDER BY 3 ASC

SELECT o.id AS "#", o.created_at AS "Создан", u.email AS "Покупатель", sp.shop_name AS "Магазин", o.status::text AS "Статус", o.total AS "Сумма" FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.buyer_id JOIN seller_profiles sp ON sp.id = o.seller_id WHERE o.created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id AS "#", o.created_at AS "Создан", u.email AS "Покупатель", o.status::text AS "Статус", o.total AS "Сумма" FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.buyer_id WHERE lower(o.status::text) IN ('cancelled','returned') ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
